analysis.purpose: The test suite for enrich-cli — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: W7 crib enrich --auto (no --provider) — no longer writes stubs; W7 crib enrich run --provider <name> — grounded provider advances coverage; W7 crib enrich run --provider <name> — provider failure leaves work pending and.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of enrich-cli
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
